digest.component_or_area: LLM completion verification and recovery orchestration (completion.py, completion_recovery.py, epic_bug_screen.py)
propositions: completion.py at 800 LOC and completion_recovery.py at 799 LOC exceed CI module-size cap, blocking any further edits without prior extraction
completion.py conflates four distinct concerns: operation orchestration, child-closure gate, epic-bug screen DET layer, and verdict reconciliation across separate call-graph clusters
completion_recovery.py conflates three concerns: criteria surface/admission bounds/coverage contract, failure taxonomy/exhaustion classification, and recovery orchestration across distinct consumers
Behavior-preserving decomposition along call-graph seams moves concerns into separate modules while keeping documented public exports stable via re-exports at the original facade locations
All moved symbols must remain patchable at their runtime call sites (monkeypatch/patch/importlib/getattr); every dotted name must be swept as a string across src+tests to catch orphaned patch targets
Refactored modules must each fall within 200–500 LOC; largest src/rebar file must remain ≤800 LOC after completion
